tools.name: effect_docs_search
tools.description: Searches the Effect documentation. Result content can be accessed with the `get_effect_doc` tool.

query.description: The search query to look for in the documentation.

tools.name: get_effect_doc
tools.description: Get the Effect documentation for a documentId. The content might be paginated. Use the `page` parameter to specify which page to retrieve.

documentId.description: The unique identifier for the Effect documentation entry.

page.description: The page number to retrieve for the document content.

resources.name: Writing Effect Code Guide - Learn the basics of writing Effect code
resources.description:
Essential information for writing Effect code, including:

- Writing basic Effect code
- Writing Effect functions
- Error handling in Effect
- Defining & using Effect services
- Declaring your domain models with Schema
- Adding observability to your Effect code
- Testing Effect code
- Common patterns in Effect code (HttpApi, HttpClient, ManagedRuntime etc.)
